title: Collapsible log panels in TecFactory agent monitor
description: We might want to redo the agents- structure for this one and redo the tasks in here.Add expand/collapse functionality to the live log output panels on the TecFactory agents screen. Each agent's log area should have a toggle button (e.g., a chevron or minimize/maximize icon) that allows users to collapse the log output to a single-line summary (agent name + status) or expand it to show the full streaming output. This saves vertical space when monitoring multiple agents simultaneously. Collapsed state should be per-agent and persist for the session. Consider adding a global 'collapse all / expand all' control as well.
